title: Briefing. Massive Jobs Restatement, Rates Go Nowhere, Apple M&A?, Earnings Updates

reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research Podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to the Synopsis, a Speedwell Research Podcast. My name is Drew Cohen, and this episode of the Synopsis is actually going to be a brand new episode format. Sunday morning we released a new weekly newsletter called The Investors Briefing.

key_points.text: The impetus of this was basically that there is a lot of different financial information available.
key_points.evidence_quote: The impetus of this was basically that there is a lot of different financial information available, but I found that it was very hard to just very quickly find the few sort of things that mattered in markets during the week, without all of the opinion and fluff.

key_points.text: A lot of times these articles would kind of redundantly repeat the same sort of things again and again.
key_points.evidence_quote: A lot of times these articles would kind of redundantly repeat the same sort of things again and again, and I found myself wasting a lot of time reading things that didn't really matter.

key_points.text: And so the reason why we wanted to create this new newsletter format was to provide readers with a very quick sort of synopsis on what happened in markets during the week.
key_points.evidence_quote: And so the reason why we wanted to create this new newsletter format was to provide readers with a very quick sort of synopsis on what happened in markets during the week, and also tie in some notable company information, not just on companies that we cover, but other companies as well.

key_points.text: And so this podcast is going to be called The Briefing.
key_points.evidence_quote: And so this podcast is going to be called The Briefing, and I'm going to read the weekly newsletter in this podcast for people who prefer to listen to it instead of read it.
